headline: Growth accelerates as margins expand and guidance rises
summary_short: Q2 revenue rose 13.1% y/y (9.8% q/q) to $1.31B, GAAP net income grew 38.5% y/y to $249.1M, and diluted EPS of $0.64 was up 42.2% y/y as operating margin expanded 590bps to 24.3%.
summary_long: Revenue grew 9.8% q/q and 13.1% y/y to $1.31B, led by international growth of 19% (16% organic) outpacing 11% U.S. growth. GAAP operating margin expanded 590bps y/y to 24.3% as gross margin rose to 63.4% from 59.5% while opex grew slower than revenue. Net income rose 38.5% y/y to $249.1M and diluted EPS grew 42.2% y/y to $0.64 (non-GAAP EPS $0.70). Cash and equivalents fell 4.7% y/y to $1.11B, though total cash-plus-securities liquidity was $1.95B with the revolver undrawn. Dexcom raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $5.18-5.25B and raised non-GAAP gross-margin, operating-margin, and Adjusted EBITDA-margin guidance, citing confidence from its Investor Day outlook and the CONNECT trial results.

drivers.explanation: International revenue grew 19% (16% organic), outpacing 11% U.S. growth; reported growth of 13% exceeded organic growth of 12%, reflecting a modest FX and acquired-revenue tailwind.
Margin expansion is largely explained by revenue growing 13.1% y/y while total operating expenses grew only 7.5% y/y, producing the disclosed 590bps of operating-margin gain.

Company raised FY2026 revenue guidance and raised non-GAAP gross-margin, operating-margin, and Adjusted EBITDA-margin guidance, citing confidence following its Investor Day long-term outlook and positive CONNECT trial results.
